source.scope: All 24 jobs in the main GPU queue, including its four-pair smoke job.

metadata.grid: Each response array is ordered (anchor, angle of first named direction, angle of second named direction). Angles in degrees, response in activation L2 units.
metadata.kway: Saved single-direction and mixture response curves, normalized mixture weights, single-direction threshold angles, direction names and overlap bound.
metadata.toy: Each JSON is a seed, dimension, base-noise and perturbation-range cell. Every row is a summary over feature pairs or k-way sets. Raw toy response surfaces were not retained.
metadata.redactions: Anchor text, token sequences, direction tensors, checkpoints, runtime logs, and machine configuration are excluded. Grid metadata retains the ordered-input SHA-256, number of unique prefixes and prefix length; direction alignment stores precomputed scalar cosines.
metadata.anchor_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(ordered_token_sequences, sort_keys=True) using Python default separators.
metadata.file_hashes: Each SHA-256 covers uncompressed file bytes. Files contains each archive member except the duplicate internal MANIFEST.json itself.
